findings.title: Restored unverified or partially synchronized material can be omitted by Send/Queue
findings.sourceTrigger: Restore text+attachment metadata. Input.restore retains selected item as error/unverified; browser itself expects zero official composer attachments before Browse. Thread submit computes capture only when composer.attachments.length>0 and does not compare Input selected items; recovery/session/profile send reasons do not include draft-material completeness. The same source branch sends a partial subset if only some restored items have reached composer.
findings.impact: The source path allows an explicit Send/Queue to omit originally selected draft files without explicit removal. Full original refs requirement is not met; this is source inference, not a runtime reproduction.
findings.required: Before either command authority takes a receipt/HTTP, original private binding must validate complete current draft material selection and its composer handoff; unverified or missing items must preserve draft and cause zero new command HTTP with a clear reason. Exclude separately held/consumed/inTransit old material correctly so a legitimate next plain draft is not blocked by an old receipt. Explicit user removal must be the intentional path to a smaller selection.
findings.validation: Add real binding/Thread seam tests for restored unverified file+text, two files with only one ready, Send and Queue, no receipt/HTTP and draft intact; explicit removal then send, plus old held receipt/new independent draft.

findings.title: Staged directory verification can reverse restored attachment order
findings.sourceTrigger: Restore Input order A,B. First authorized directory page contains only B: sync skips A(error) then appends B. A later directory page verifies A: sync appends A after existing B. Thread capture passes composer IDs B,A; Input.capture maps those IDs in supplied order. Current direct fixture returns both resources together, so it does not exercise this sequence.
findings.impact: Saved order is not preserved when verification is split across pages or searches; new command material ordering can differ from the restored draft. Not an observed runtime failure.
findings.required: Keep original selected ordering through partial verification and actual official composer handoff, with no automatic upload/content fetch, reselection or remount. Do not use reordered composer IDs to silently redefine a saved selection.
findings.validation: Restore A,B, confirm B then A through controlled real Input list pages, assert final original IDs/refs order and exactly once composer insertion; include explicit removal and held-material isolation.
